instruction: I want Thunderbird to compose emails using plain text format by default instead of HTML. Can you configure it to use plain text for composing?

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Thunderbird to compose emails in plain text format. The evaluator checks if mail.identity.default.compose_html preference is set to false. Standard Thunderbird preference with similar complexity to original theme task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) which is the right location for this setting
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) properly parses the preferences file using regex and JSON parsing
Expected value is semantically correct: mail.identity.default.compose_html=false means plain text composing is enabled
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are written to disk before verification
Complete coverage: instruction requires configuring plain text composing, evaluator checks exactly that preference
Logic flow is sound and will work correctly at runtime
All-or-nothing scoring is appropriate for a single boolean preference check

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
